# PaperPilot Tools — buyer-focused technical services

> AI-assisted original software from one actual economic owner. This site is a free public guide, not an instant payment gateway. Prices are conditional offers until a real buyer agrees to their terms.

## Free public examples
- [Free local CSV checker](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/csv-quality-api.html#local-preview): runs inside your browser, up to 32 KiB UTF-8, no upload, login or payment. Structural warnings, not proof of correct accounting or safety.
- [Installable zero-charge CSV preflight agent skill](https://github.com/livastic-vm1-primary/paperpilot-tools/tree/main/.agents/skills/paperpilot-csv-preflight): `npx skills add livastic-vm1-primary/paperpilot-tools --skill paperpilot-csv-preflight`, then run its included `scripts/preflight.cjs --demo` locally; up to 32 KiB UTF-8, no input upload, no wallet, no auto-payment. An optional **separate** VM5 paid API is buyer-authorized only.
- [Free synthetic merchant example](https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/csv-sample): GET, fictional data, no purchase.
- [Korean freelance estimate guide](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/freelance-estimate-ko.html): illustrative calculation, not a certified tax invoice.

- [Free x402 v2 quote decoder](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/x402-inspector.html): read the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header/unsigned JSON locally. Shows Base USDC asset address, 6-decimal amount, recipient payTo, bounded server-reported error text (unverified) and warnings; compare buyer-supplied EXPECTED USDC invoice amount with the 402 quote EXACTLY and fail-closed on independent publicly reported 0.10-versus-1000USDC placeholder/merchant invoice_not_found flags. A matching amount never authorizes a real wallet. No network fetch, wallet, account, signing, charge or fraud/merchant-identity certification. No user adoption or payments assumed.

- [Free local trade-ID CSV duplicate audit](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/tradeid-audit.html): spot exact repeated rows, repeated/missing stable trade/fill/execution/order identifiers, and equal amounts with DISTINCT IDs; refuse amount-only conclusions. Up to 256 KiB / 750 rows, local-only, no wallet/payment/analytics, no actual sales or tax verdicts. Optional existing 15 USDC DeFi exception review is a separate written buyer-authorized pilot, not an automatic checkout.

- [Verified free opt-in Trade-ID review quote inquiry](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/contact.html?service=tradeid-review): one already activated login-free consent-required FormSubmit email form, preselected original 15-native-Base-USDC up-to-50-anonymized-rows pilot; NO payment/charge on enquiry, terms require individual written agreement, no customer yet.
- [Optional original 15 native Base Circle USDC manual Trade-ID CSV review on Clawlancer](https://clawlancer.ai/marketplace/94393ff6-eef4-4a25-8645-d679145c9edf): one buyer-authorized nonconfidential/anonymized exchange trade export up to 50 rows, row-number evidence separating exact duplicates from equal quantities with different IDs, scoped human-reviewed report. PUBLIC active FIXED listing using same one-owner VM1 seller wallet; verified purchases=0, paid buyer/order and escrow release NOT independently tested, and user must check marketplace funding/terms. The observed signed-out human listing calls this seller FIXED offer “Bounty / Open for claims” and has no visible buyer purchase button, so it is NOT verified one-click checkout. Use the separate opt-in FormSubmit inquiry instead. Separate from free local-only checker and any tax advice.

- [Free offline EVM explorer CSV hash-discovery reference](https://github.com/livastic-vm1-primary/paperpilot-tools/tree/main/examples/evm-explorer-hash-preflight): Python3 stdlib source and 20 fictional local tests for Etherscan-like Transaction Hash imports; dedup only for RPC lookup, NEVER economic Transfer logs; 5,000 row warning and fail-closed chain identity caveat. Third-party rotki project did not commission or approve it. No network or wallet.

- [Free browser-only USDC invoice ↔ Transfer CSV exception candidate preview](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/usdc-invoice-reconcile.html): Base8453 exact Circle token address, six-decimal BigInt arithmetic, row-numbered candidate exact/partial/overpaid plus strict duplicate event/chain/token/to-address/ref quarantine. Entirely local, no network, uploaded invoices, wallet connection or proof of real transfer/finality; synthetic demo available. Merchants must check real canonical transfer logs independently.
- [Opt-in proposed USD 49 per pilot USDC invoice reconciliation inquiry](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/contact.html?service=usdc-invoice-pilot): an original existing activated contact form with explicit third-party FormSubmit consent, up to 50 anonymized report candidates, no checkout or payment on inquiry. The 49 USD rate is unvalidated hypothesis, independently authorized real client contracts=0, actual separately attributable receipts=0. Merchant scope, Base USDC exact amount, KYC/payee where legally needed and terms need explicit written agreement.

- [Free local-only manual Koinly column mapper](https://livastic-vm1-primary.github.io/paperpilot-tools/koinly-column-mapper.html): explicit source header selection into original Simple/Trades/Universal Koinly field names, no dropped or merged rows, preserved original unused columns, UTC checkbox required, source-formula injection blocked, output candidate file downloaded only on separate user action. No Koinly login, remote data upload, wallet, imported tax results, claims of paid users or official vendor endorsement. Complements the separately developed SAME-OWNER VM3 Koinly format preflight.

- [Optional original HashN small Koinly CSV mapping review: proposed 5 native Circle USDC / up to 10 sanitized source rows](https://hashn.com/store/886ed287-aaca-434b-9f27-560a50bfbbb6/listings/koinly-csv-one-source-mapping-mini-review-5usdc.md): existing ONE real beneficial owner's original HashN seller account public listing, HTTP201 API new offer and HTTP200 independent public readback, original free Koinly source/tool and fabricated examples remain free. One buyer-requested manual header map, preserved candidate CSV if safely convertible, integrity note and one clarification. No Koinly importer/tax certificate, wallet login, automatic purchase, customer files in a public message, escrow guarantee or externally verified paid buyer. Not the separate hypothetical USD49/50-row larger engagement. Native Base8453 Circle USDC terms require independent prior written agreement.

Real buyer-paid POST success NOT independently verified; never treat a quote or connected wallet as income.

The current unsigned valid request returns HTTP 402; malformed input returns HTTP 400 before payment. Quotes are NOT purchases. No independently verified paid POST customers at this time.
